meta.name: dare-research-engine
meta.description: Use the DARE research engine to crystallize research goals, write executable research specs, and execute staged research workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将研究目标转化为可执行的研究流程并自动执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统化执行多步骤研究任务
copy.tagline_en: Turn research goals into executable specs and run staged workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically execute multi-step research tasks

howto.what: Claude 会使用 DARE 研究引擎来明确研究目标、编写可执行的研究规范，并执行分阶段的研究工作流。
howto.when: 当你说出需要研究或规划研究项目的指令时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 DARE 研究引擎规划一个关于 AI 伦理的研究项目。
say.note: Claude 会启动研究引擎并编写研究规范。

say.text: 使用 DARE 引擎执行第一阶段的研究规范。
say.note: Claude 会读取并执行预设的研究规范。

say.text: 运行 DARE 研究引擎来明确我的研究目标。
say.note: Claude 会引导你明确研究目标。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the DARE research engine to crystallize research goals, write executable research specs, and execute staged research workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you give instructions related to research or planning a research project.

say_en.text: Use the DARE research engine to plan a research project on AI ethics.
say_en.note: Claude will start the engine and write research specs.

say_en.text: Execute the first stage of the research spec using DARE.
say_en.note: Claude will read and execute the preset spec.

say_en.text: Run the DARE research engine to crystallize my research goals.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to clarify goals.
